title: GENDER INFERENCE: CAN CHATGPT OUTPERFORM COMMON COMMERCIAL TOOLS?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the prediction accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-scores of several commercial gender inference tools and ChatGPT to identify algorithmic performance disparities when classifying female versus male names.

Evaluating the performance degradation of gender inference tools on non-Western demographics by comparing their accuracy on names from predominantly English-speaking countries (e.g., US, UK, Canada, Australia) versus East Asian countries (e.g., China, Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong).

Comparing the accuracy of gender inference tools on names of Olympic medalists (individuals with high media coverage and celebrity status) versus non-medalists to test if the models disproportionately perform better on well-represented, famous entities.
